articles.title: FACE Amusement Group Wins IAAPA Brass Ring Award for Talent Acquisition
articles.summary: FACE Amusement Group, a multi-location FEC operator based in Johnson City, Tenn., has been recognized with the IAAPA Brass Ring Excellence Award for Best Talent Acquisition Program. The award highlights the company's innovative approach to recruiting, developing, and retaining staff across its growing portfolio of entertainment destinations. For FEC operators struggling with staffing challenges, this recognition offers a benchmark for best practices in workforce strategy.

articles.title: accesso Launches Agentic AI for Automated Workflows at Visitor Attractions
articles.summary: accesso Technology Group has introduced agentic AI capabilities within its accesso Intelligence platform, enabling visitor attractions to automate analysis, forecasting, and reporting workflows. The new tools are designed to reduce manual operational burdens and help teams make faster, data-driven decisions. FEC operators using accesso systems should evaluate how these AI-driven automations could improve efficiency in ticketing, capacity planning, and revenue management.

articles.title: Launch Entertainment to Open Trampoline Park and Duckpin Bowling Venue at Denton Mall
articles.summary: Launch Entertainment is set to open a new FEC at Golden Triangle Mall in Denton, Texas, featuring trampolines, an arcade, and duckpin bowling. The opening is part of a broader trend of FECs repurposing vacant anchor retail spaces in malls. This format — combining active attractions with social gaming — reflects current consumer demand for diversified entertainment under one roof.

articles.title: 24 Indoor Launches Monkey Town Brand in UK with Three October Openings
articles.summary: Dutch indoor play operator 24 Indoor is formally entering the UK market with three simultaneous Monkey Town venue openings in October 2026, bringing a brand already well established in the Netherlands and Germany to British families. The rapid multi-site launch signals growing confidence in the UK indoor play market and could increase competitive pressure on existing operators. FEC investors and operators should take note of this international chain's expansion strategy.

articles.title: $50M EVO Entertainment Center Clears Key Hurdle in Clearwater, Florida
articles.summary: The Clearwater City Council voted 3-2 to approve street closures needed to advance a $50 million EVO Entertainment Center development in downtown Clearwater. The contentious vote highlights the regulatory and community relations challenges large-scale FEC developments often face in urban settings. The project's progress is a useful case study for operators and developers navigating municipal approvals for major entertainment venues.

articles.title: The Experience Economy Matures: What Comes Next for Operators and Investors
articles.summary: A detailed industry analysis argues the experience economy has transitioned from an emerging sector to an established industry, with IP-driven experiences, reimagined venues, and live entertainment redefining the space. Leaders are now focused on creative integrity, commercial sustainability, and global expansion rather than simply proving the concept works. FEC operators and investors will find this a valuable strategic framework as they plan for the next phase of growth.

articles.title: Apex Entertainment Signs NIL Deal with Syracuse Basketball Stars
articles.summary: Apex Entertainment, a multi-location FEC chain, has signed Syracuse basketball players Sadiq White Jr. and Olivia Schmitt as NIL brand ambassadors. The partnership is an innovative marketing move that ties college athlete popularity to local FEC venues, potentially driving younger demographic foot traffic. FEC operators should watch this NIL strategy as a cost-effective alternative to traditional sports sponsorships.

articles.title: Chuck E. Cheese Adventure World Makes International Debut in Mexico
articles.summary: Chuck E. Cheese has launched its Adventure World concept in Mexico, marking the brand's first international foray with this upgraded format. The move signals that the company is accelerating its global growth strategy alongside its domestic brand refresh. FEC operators and franchisors should monitor how the Adventure World format performs internationally as a gauge of scalable FEC models.

articles.title: Alabama Adventure Rolls Out Dual Halloween Offerings for 2026 Season
articles.summary: Alabama Adventure is running two parallel fall events — FearFest for thrill-seekers and a new family-friendly Adventure Fall Festival — to maximize audience reach across the Halloween season. The dual-track approach allows the park to monetize the season without alienating families with young children. This strategy is increasingly common among FEC and regional park operators looking to extend seasonal revenue.

articles.title: Kings Dominion Debuts IP-Driven Haunted Maze Based on Diablo Video Game Franchise
articles.summary: Kings Dominion has opened DIABLO: The Infernal Path, a haunted maze developed in partnership with Blizzard Entertainment's iconic Diablo video game franchise during Halloween Haunt. The attraction is one of only two of its kind, underscoring the growing role of gaming IP in driving themed entertainment experiences. FEC and park operators should note the strong consumer pull that established gaming brands can generate for seasonal attractions.

articles.title: Gröna Lund Announces Radar-Based Interactive Dark Ride for 2027
articles.summary: Stockholm's Gröna Lund has unveiled SCORE!, a new interactive dark ride for 2027 developed with Vekoma featuring a unique radar-based ride system and immersive gaming narrative created with Jora Vision. The radar technology allows for more dynamic, responsive guest interaction than traditional gun-based systems. This signals a new direction in interactive ride technology that FEC and park operators investing in dark rides should closely follow.

articles.title: Efteling Unveils World-First Vekoma WaveCatcher Ride Opening December 2026
articles.summary: Efteling in the Netherlands will open Ravenring on December 1, the world's first installation of Vekoma's new WaveCatcher attraction, which combines a sensation of flight with rider-controlled movement. The attraction is part of a broader reimagining of Efteling's Raveleijn area. Suppliers and park operators scouting next-generation family ride systems should pay close attention to how this new ride format performs at one of Europe's premier parks.

articles.title: New Workshop Helps Attractions Industry Teams Navigate Sustainability and Business Risk
articles.summary: Valumia founder Verónica Celis Vergara has launched Paper Trail, a card-based simulation workshop designed specifically for attractions industry teams to explore how investment, procurement, supply chain, and operational decisions interconnect with sustainability and business risk. Players take on roles including park operators, investors, and suppliers to collaboratively manage a simulated new amusement park. FEC leadership teams looking to build organizational resilience and ESG awareness will find this a practical professional development tool.

articles.title: Center Parcs Launches Free Sensory Library for Neurodivergent Guests
articles.summary: Center Parcs has introduced a Sensory Library at its Elveden Forest site offering free borrowing of sensory tools, noise-reducing equipment, and communication aids for neurodivergent children and families, with no diagnosis required. The initiative, developed with SEN specialist SENNIES, is planned to roll out across all six UK and Ireland villages by 2028. FEC operators looking to improve inclusivity and widen their audience should consider similar low-cost accessibility programs.

articles.title: First Renderings Revealed for MADCAPS Entertainment Center in Maricopa, Arizona
articles.summary: New renderings have been released offering the first detailed look at MADCAPS, an upcoming entertainment center planned for Maricopa, Arizona. The project adds to a wave of new FEC developments targeting fast-growing suburban markets in the Sun Belt. Local operators and suppliers in the region should track this project as a potential competitive development.

articles.title: NRG Adventure Park Moves Forward with Build-Out in Jacksonville, Florida
articles.summary: NRG Adventure Park is advancing through permitting and construction phases for its new location in Southside Commons in Jacksonville, bringing an adventure-focused FEC concept to a high-traffic retail corridor. The project reflects continued investor confidence in the suburban FEC market in the Southeast. Operators and developers watching the Florida market should note this as a sign of sustained demand for active entertainment venues.

articles.title: Family Entertainment Center Coming to Former Big Lots Space in Wenatchee, Washington
articles.summary: A family entertainment center is planned for a vacant Big Lots retail space in Wenatchee, Washington, continuing the trend of FECs repurposing former big-box retail locations. Adaptive reuse of these large-footprint spaces offers FEC operators relatively affordable square footage in established retail corridors. This story is a useful reference point for operators and developers evaluating similar real estate opportunities.

articles.title: Indian FEC Reopens After Major Redevelopment
articles.summary: An Indian family entertainment center has reopened its doors following a significant redevelopment project, signaling continued investment in the FEC sector across South Asia. The redevelopment reflects growing consumer appetite for upgraded entertainment experiences in India's expanding middle-class market. FEC suppliers and international operators eyeing the Indian market should track this activity as an indicator of sector momentum.

articles.title: Playaza Entertainments Plans 10 New Outlets Across South India in 18 Months
articles.summary: Indian FEC operator Playaza Entertainments has announced plans to open 10 new locations across South India within the next 18 months, signaling aggressive regional expansion in one of the world's fastest-growing entertainment markets. The rapid growth plan reflects rising consumer demand for organized, branded indoor entertainment in Tier 2 and Tier 3 Indian cities. Suppliers and international FEC brands considering the Indian market should monitor Playaza's expansion as a bellwether.

articles.title: India's Indoor Entertainment Sector Embraces Indigenous Manufacturing and Innovation
articles.summary: Industry leader Ankur Maheshwary discusses how India's indoor entertainment sector is evolving through homegrown innovation and domestic manufacturing of attractions equipment, reducing dependence on imports. The shift is enabling faster, more cost-effective FEC rollouts across the country. International suppliers should take note of this trend as it may reshape competitive dynamics in one of Asia's most promising FEC growth markets.

articles.title: Indian Company Wins ₹24 Crore Order to Build Country's Largest Indoor Go-Kart Track
articles.summary: CSML has secured a ₹24 crore contract to construct what will be India's first and largest indoor go-karting track, a milestone for the country's growing attractions sector. The project underscores surging investor interest in premium active entertainment formats in India. FEC operators and go-kart suppliers with international ambitions should view this as a significant market signal.

articles.title: ProSlide Unveils ATRIUM Innovation for Indoor Water Parks at IAAPA Expo Europe
articles.summary: ProSlide has launched ATRIUM, a dome-shaped fiberglass structure that allows indoor water parks to extend the TornadoWAVE 60 ride outside the building envelope while preserving the indoor guest experience and natural light. The innovation frees up valuable interior floor space and opens new design possibilities for constrained indoor water park layouts. Water park operators and FEC developers planning aquatic attractions should evaluate ATRIUM as a space-efficiency solution.

articles.title: IAAPA Expo Europe 2026 Draws Industry to London's ExCeL
articles.summary: The European attractions industry converged on London's ExCeL venue for IAAPA Expo Europe 2026, with a wide range of new product launches, award presentations, and business announcements from major suppliers and operators. The event served as a showcase for the latest innovations in rides, technology, and guest experience across the leisure and entertainment sectors. FEC operators and suppliers should review the key product debuts and deal announcements emerging from the show.

articles.title: IAAPA Expo Europe 2026 Brass Ring Best Exhibit Award Winners Announced
articles.summary: IAAPA has announced the winners of the Brass Ring Best Exhibit Awards from IAAPA Expo Europe 2026, recognizing outstanding supplier booth presentations across multiple categories on the show floor. These awards highlight the suppliers and manufacturers making the strongest impressions on FEC buyers and park operators at one of the industry's most important annual trade events. FEC procurement teams should use the winners list as a shortlist of vendors to evaluate.

articles.title: Morey's Piers Executive Elected to IAAPA Global Board Leadership Track
articles.summary: Denise Beckson, VP and Chief Administrative Officer at Morey's Piers, has been elected Second Vice Chair of the IAAPA Global Board of Directors, placing her on the path to become Board Chair in 2029. Her election reflects the growing influence of independent regional operators within the global attractions association's governance. FEC industry stakeholders should follow her leadership trajectory as it may shape association policy relevant to smaller operators.
